source_note: This is station-front/crossing composition; railway platform is intentionally not emphasized because it is not visible in the reference photos.
next_actions: Add facade material randomization and dirt decals.
Increase sign/panel contrast and add road surface wear.
Add stronger contact shadow or ambient occlusion below DOM feet.
Render a lower, more photographic station-front camera angle.
Use local OpenVINO for texture/decal generation rather than replacing the whole scene.
findings: City density passes the first practical gate: windows, signs, crosswalks, and street furniture are present.
Material realism is intentionally scored low until PBR variation, dirt decals, glass reflection, and facade color variation are added.
Lighting is basic Blender sky/sun/fill lighting; UE5 Lumen or stronger atmospheric control is still future work.
Camera is composed for station-front review, but not yet a cinematic 35/50/85mm shot sequence.
Character integration has visible placement, but contact shadow/AO should be strengthened for final release.
